facts.content: Patient reports shallow breathing following a wasp sting.
Patient reports lip tingling without swelling after the wasp sting.
Patient reports chest tightness after the wasp sting.
Patient reports a blotchy rash on the body after the wasp sting.
Patient has a history of eczema.
Patient has a penicillin allergy listed in past medical history.
Patient has antihistamines available at home.
There is a suspected anaphylactic reaction secondary to a wasp sting with respiratory symptoms and urticaria.
